jobDescription: A fund administrator that settles subscriptions and redemptions for about 200 UK-domiciled funds is hiring a settlements operations supervisor. The supervisor oversees daily settlement, makes and records escalation decisions on failed settlements before the cut-off, reconciles cash with the custodian each morning, keeps the team's platform procedures current and coaches team members using the quality-check results. Quarter-end volumes are about four times the daily average, and the operations director reviews every failed-settlement decision after the event, so decisions are expected to be logged with a time and a reason.
requirements: Supervises the daily settlement of fund subscriptions and redemptions.
Makes and records escalation decisions on failed settlements within cut-off times.
Reconciles cash positions with the custodian each morning.
Maintains the team's procedures for the settlement platform.
Coaches team members on quality-check results and tracks their competency sign-offs.

evidence.text: Settlements supervisor at Harbourline Fund Services, June 2020 to present, supervising a team of six who settle subscriptions and redemptions for 140 funds.
Ran the morning cash reconciliation against the custodian's statements and cleared breaks before the 11:00 funding deadline, logging any break carried forward with its reason.
Kept the decision log for failed settlements, recording for each item whether it was resubmitted, paid manually or escalated to treasury, together with the time of the decision.
Rewrote the settlement-platform procedures after the 2023 system upgrade, covering trade capture, cut-off monitoring and manual payment controls.
Held one-to-one coaching sessions when a team member's quality-check error rate rose above the team's monthly threshold, using the failed checks as worked examples.

Work sample: the anonymised failed-settlement decision log for the March 2024 quarter-end, listing 14 items with the decision taken on each and its timestamp against the cut-off, with the operations director's sign-off at the foot of the log.

Reference check (written reply from the former operations director, received 2 October): confirms that the candidate made the resubmit, manual-payment or escalation call on failed settlements during the 2023 and 2024 quarter-ends and that the director reviewed the logs afterwards.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate's notice period is eight weeks and they can attend an on-site session on 21 or 23 October.

propositions.text: The candidate made and logged escalation decisions on failed settlements, including 14 items at the March 2024 quarter-end recorded with timestamps against the cut-off and signed off by the operations director.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the decision log, the work sample shows the March 2024 log with sign-off, and the reference confirms the candidate made the calls.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the morning cash reconciliation against the custodian's statements before the funding deadline.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the reconciliation directly.

propositions.text: The candidate rewrote the settlement-platform procedures after the 2023 system upgrade.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry names the procedures and their scope.

gold.expectedGap: Coaching sessions are described, but no competency sign-off records are documented.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the logged decisions and the director's sign-off as supported evidence; do not describe the decisions as approved in advance or extend them beyond the quarter-ends stated.
followUpTargets: Ask how the candidate tracked team members' competency sign-offs after coaching, and where those records are kept.
